description: Check what DrinkedIn publicly shows for one venue. Send its DrinkedIn page URL or its own website as url, or a register key (licence_source, for example ny_sla) and licence_id. Returns the public bar-page fields, whether the listing is officially validated, the type of evidence (licence register, premises census, the venue's own site or own social page) and how to ask for a correction. Read-only: it changes nothing and records no correction. Street address, phone, website and licence id are not returned. A listing that is not public is reported as not_found. For people of legal drinking age where they are.

licence_id.description: The licence or premises id on that register.

licence_source.description: Register key, for example ny_sla. Send with licence_id.

url.description: The venue's DrinkedIn page (https://drinkedin.net/bars/<id>) or its own website. Directory and review sites are refused.

name: drinkedin_check_listing
